protocol.infrastructure_policy: retain_and_review; never retry a scored algorithm or budget failure
protocol.cutoff_policy: terminal cutoff; grade preserved artifacts once with frozen verifier; do not continue solving
protocol.valid_success: integrity and all frozen A/B/D/P checks; no extra parallelism criterion
protocol.train_test_grouping: All views with the same project-original DAG300 source family must share a split.
protocol.network_enforcement: Docker Compose network_mode:none on agent and verifier
protocol.harbor_dispatcher_network_policy: default public; overridden by task-authored Docker network namespace none
protocol.admission: Structure M, five valid trials, 2 or 3 strict successes; inspect failed trials for core-business evidence before admission.

X13.reason: 五次严格通过2/5，公开检查5/5，核心55/60。r2在第11、12例进程失败，r4第11例超时，r5第11、12例超时；三次均正常结束模型阶段，未触发token或总时限截止。两种精确参考方法在实际Linux环境解出同一12例，失败涉及正常48–84事件、3–4场次的核心可扩展性。r2的进程退出不能单独确认为OOM，按原始process类别记录；不重试这些已评分大用例。任意合法同优排程均可通过。旧W13五次全过，新版仅替换四个更大业务输入，是公开登记的规模对照，结构仍A1/S0/C2/I1、实测中档。
